text: Only openapi.json mentions radar by name. Search source dirs for related terms (clip, mode switch, list) in apps/domains.
command: cd /work && timeout 25 grep -rliE 'radar|RadarList|radar_mode|radarMode' apps domains functions platform --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.py --include=*.css 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30
